name: Proofreader application
about: Apply for proofreading a PDF in Preview status
title: 'Proofreader Application:'
labels: 'proodreader_application'

---

**Project Code** (to be filled by applicant)
One project code to proofread such as "ASV" or "GOV"

**Language Code** (to be filled by applicant)
One project code to proofread such as "ja-JP" or "de-DE"

**Proofread Team** (to be filled by applicant)
Team Lead: (full name, gitthub ID) e.g., John Doe, @JohnDoe_Github
Team Members: (full name, gitthub ID)

Notes:
- github ID is required for all proofreaders.
- 2 to 4 proofreaders recommended for neutrality.
- The project PDF must be in Preview status.
- Application will be reviewed by the project owner immediately, like in a few day.
- Proofread will be done not on the Arxiv repo but the project build repository managed by the project owner.
